how.title: How it works
how.lede: We consolidate public and proprietary databases that feed our artificial intelligence, FLEo1. The AI orchestrates the study and our SINcopi algorithm solves the case.
how.figure_alt: Method diagram in three stages joined by one continuous line: public databases (ONS, ANEEL, EPE, IBGE, Copernicus), private data and proprietary bases enter a busbar; FLEo1 picks case, load level, cut, scenarios, contingencies and model; SINcopi solves over the MW ladder with n-1 screening and returns a band and a verdict, with the official NEWAVE, DECOMP and DESSEM chain as reference and open models running the same case for comparison.

parts.title: Data
parts.body: Public power-sector databases, the client's private data and proprietary bases enter the same case, with origin and date recorded.

parts.title: FLEo1
parts.body: FLEo1, our artificial intelligence, assembles the study: it picks case, cut, scenarios and model, and records every decision as the basis of the answer.

parts.title: SINcopi
parts.body: SINcopi solves the case on the real grid and returns an MW band and a verdict. Open models run the same case; the official chain is the reference.

customers.name: Generation
customers.body: Where the grid curtails your generation, and how much. The map crosses solar and wind potential, transmission lines and the curtailment ONS records per cluster, month by month, for one plant or for the whole portfolio at once. It is the basis for curtailment scenarios and for PPA planning at scale.
customers.frame_aria: Generation map screen: map of Brazil with clusters by curtailment, two monthly curtailment charts and the list of the five most curtailed clusters in the window July 2025 to June 2026

customers.name: Transmission & Distribution
customers.body: An access inquiry arrives and the utility screens its own network against the requested load: every bus at once, each with a band, a verdict and a robustness. A flexible load enters as a filter of the same screening. The answer leaves as a pack, basis stated, and the same case answers the next inquiry.
customers.frame_aria: Inquiry Desk screen: inquiry queue, the 300 MW request in Pernambuco and the screening of the network's buses against that load, with bands and verdicts

customers.name: Data Centers
customers.body: Where a large new load fits today on the Rede Básica, in what band and how robustly. Every substation in the region gets a verdict per MW step, a headroom band and a time class, all on the same case; when the model cannot say, it withholds and states why. It is speed-to-power measured at scale: the whole region, not one site at a time.
customers.frame_aria: Atlas screen: map of the Northeast with the mapped substations and their verdicts, the list ranked by headroom band and substation Garanhuns II selected
